stories.title: Sailors report food shortages and suicide attempts on USS Abraham Lincoln
new_facts: Sailor texts reveal food shortages (no milk 3 months, rotten meat) on USS Abraham Lincoln deployed since November.
Multiple sailors attempted to go overboard on USS Abraham Lincoln during 9-month Middle East deployment.
Lawmakers are demanding answers from Navy about USS Abraham Lincoln conditions and overboard attempts.
Navy official denies increase in suicidal ideations or attempts; ~5,000 personnel aboard for record 250 days.
stories.line: Sailors on USS Abraham Lincoln report severe shortages and deteriorating conditions during extended Middle East deployment; some families say crew members attempted suicide.

stories.title: Ford nears production of $28,000 Fathom EV after $2 billion factory retool
new_facts: Ford on track to complete $2B factory overhaul; Fathom EV prototype builds begin Q1 2027.
Fathom EV priced at $28,000; production at Louisville Assembly Plant; pre-tooling phase underway.
stories.line: Ford is converting a factory to mass-produce Fathom, a $28,000 electric truck competing in the affordable EV market.

stories.title: Whole Foods recalls jalapeño products in salmonella outbreak
stories.line: Whole Foods is recalling jalapeño-containing products linked to a salmonella outbreak affecting multiple states.

stories.title: Flock adds guardrails after police misuse of license plate data
new_facts: Flock CEO Garrett Langley pushes back against "evil entity" characterization while tightening guardrails.
Flock Safety announced Thursday it will implement several new safeguards to its products.
CEO Langley says "We got this one wrong" and has changed his mind on Flock's responsibility for police misuse.
stories.line: License plate camera company Flock is adding oversight controls after police used its data for unauthorized searches.

stories.title: Eurovision 2027 awarded to Bulgarian coastal city Burgas
new_facts: Russia struck Ukraine's largest Danube grain port; Ukraine hit Novorossiysk; global food price fears mount.
Eurovision 2027 awarded to Burgas, Bulgaria, after singer Dara won the contest.
stories.line: Eurovision 2027 will be held in Burgas, Bulgaria, a coastal city that hasn't hosted the contest before.

stories.title: Colombia quake rescue enters final phase as survival window narrows
new_facts: Rescuers calling for silence around rubble to listen for survivors
Firefighters rescued a trapped dog from quake rubble, boosting survivor search hopes
stories.line: Rescue crews search Colombian earthquake rubble as the window for finding survivors alive closes, with dogs and heavy equipment deployed.

stories.title: Trump press secretary Leavitt steps down
new_facts: Leavitt's departure stunned many insiders; no successor plan in place; multiple names being floated.
Trump repeatedly called Leavitt during maternity leave demanding she return, contributing to her resignation.
Leavitt's resignation left Trump with no plan to replace her; top officials will cover briefings in interim.
Leavitt departure comes less than 3 months before midterms; Trump approval hits record low per YouGov.
stories.line: Trump's press secretary Karoline Leavitt is stepping down; Scott Jennings is emerging as a top replacement candidate.

stories.title: DHS spent $464M on deportation jets now used for Trump official travel
new_facts: DHS spent $464M on 10 jets via no-bid contract; Mullin and Noem blame each other for purchase.
Senate Democrats calling for investigation; jets shuttling Trump officials instead of deportees.
DHS has formally defended the agent who pointed gun at Virginia woman but has not provided proof of its claims against her.
stories.line: DHS spent $464 million on a jet fleet for deportation operations that now shuttles Trump officials instead, with agency officials blaming each other.

stories.title: Water firms approved to raise bills by billions for leak repairs
new_facts: Ofwat provisionally approved £3.4bn investment increase by 2030 via higher customer charges.
Ofwat provisionally approved 13 water companies to charge customers more for investments.
stories.line: UK water companies win approval to charge households extra billions to fix aging infrastructure and leaks.

stories.title: Judge dismisses Trump administration antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard
new_facts: Federal judge dismisses Trump administration's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard University.
stories.line: A federal judge dismissed the Trump administration's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard, which alleged the university failed to protect Jewish students.
